dashboard.label: Telemetry Navigator - Logging Requirements and Intake
dashboard.description: Pick the technologies and risk overlays for a system to see the logging policy, standard and workbook requirements that apply, then save the request to Splunk. Saved requests appear on the Intake Tracker and the Auditor rollup.

html.p: Open the Navigator in a new tab | Intake Tracker | Auditor rollup | AEs and teams without Splunk access can use the standalone copy of the same page and send the downloaded .json with their intake ticket.
